messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty Alert fired: PD#INC-8421 — gpu-pool-west2 memory pressure (auto-suppress threshold reached)
pagerduty-bot: Alert routed to `eng-oncall` & `runtime` escalation. Pager: rosa_oncall (primary), sam_runtime (next)
rosa_oncall: Acked. I'm checking metrics now — cluster west2 GPU pool showing steady KV-cache growth + sporadic driver resets.
sam_runtime: On it, pulling traces. Any obvious customer impact?
rosa_oncall: Dashboards show 5% increase in inference 5xxs for a subset of dedicated customers (high-qps routes). Latency 95p up ~80ms.
lee_infra: Seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` / `driver reset` events on gnode-23 and gnode-26 over the last 7m. Kernel logs: ```[2025-06-12T02:12:40Z] NVRM: GPU at 0000:af:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus````
rosa_oncall: Thanks. I'm going to cordon & drain gnode-23 to force reroute. Will disable prefetch on that pool to reduce KV churn.
rosa_oncall: Command: `kubectl drain gnode-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
sam_runtime: Copy. I'll take runtime lead after drain. Planning to evict KV-cache on remaining GPUs and disable aggressive prefetch in the autoscaler.
amy_cust_success: Heads up — customers AcmeHomes and FathomAI reported spike in errors via status page. I've posted the incident notice and suggested fallback to CPU endpoints where available.
rosa_oncall: Noting customer impact in PD incident. Setting mitigation: (1) drain gnode-23, (2) set pool prefetch=false, (3) scale up cpu-fallbacks by +3 replicas.
sam_runtime: Investigating root cause — suspect fragmentation leading to driver resets when combined with recent kernel bump. Repro locally with model X using long KV sequences.
lee_infra: I've queued a quick driver roll-forward to 540.32 on a staging node to test. If good, we'll roll to the remaining nodes during low-traffic window.
rosa_oncall: Pager update: initial mitigation applied. Error rate dropping to ~1.2% on impacted routes, continuing to monitor.
sam_runtime: We'll keep pool on reduced prefetch and add aggressive KV eviction policy for 15m. If errors resurface, we'll trigger failover to smaller quantized model variant.
amy_cust_success: Notifying AcmeHomes that we've mitigations in place; will follow up with RCA and ETA for full fix.
rosa_oncall: handoff to sam_runtime for ongoing root-cause + patch. If PD escalates, sam you are primary. I'll remain on monitoring for 30m.
sam_runtime: Acknowledged. If anyone sees `driver reset` >3x on new nodes, ping me and we'll escalate to infra lead.
rosa_oncall: Closing slack thread for oncall transition — updates will be in PD incident. :thumbsup:
